channel.title: Federated-Learning on Bingjie's Blog
channel.description: Recent content in Federated-Learning on Bingjie's Blog

item.title: The Dirichlet Distribution in Federated Learning: From Probability Vectors to Non-IID Data Partitioning
item.description: Introduces the definition, concentration parameters, and statistical properties of the Dirichlet distribution, distinguishes between two directions of federated data partitioning, and provides a reproducible, complete NumPy implementation along with methods for experimental verification.

item.title: Convergence Analysis in Federated Learning (Part 5)
item.description: Deriving non-convex stationary point bounds and strongly convex error bounds under full participation from FedAvg's local updates, distinguishing gradient noise, client drift, and sampling error, while discussing partial participation and heterogeneity corrections.

item.title: Accelerating Federated Learning Simulation with MPI
item.description: Building a federated learning simulator using mpi4py and PyTorch, covering server-client architecture, MPI execution flow, multi-process execution, and experimental performance.
